name: Sprocket
text:
Decision: We should auto-apply only the *safest* class of changes to our prompts/engines/routing/own-code—those that are purely additive (e.g., adding a missing example, fixing a typo, or clarifying a comment)—and leave all structural edits (logic changes, refactors) for human review.

Reason: This keeps the system fast and low-risk while still catching the most common, low-stakes errors. The trade-off is that we’ll miss deeper improvements, but that’s better than breaking something with an automated edit. The artifact will be a simple rule set in the improve bot that flags anything beyond additive changes for human review.
